h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in North Dum Dum

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in North Dum Dum

items.pText: North Dum Dum, beside Kolkata's airport, has a large number of small private schools, nursery schools and coaching centres. For many of them, the outdoor play area is part of how they present themselves to parents. A themed play station, built around castles, robots, a circus or a forest, can give a small school a recognisable corner that children talk about at home.

FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures these themed structures at our factory in Vasai, about 1,650 km away, and sends them to West Bengal by road. Our installation team or a dealer in the region sets them up. Send us the size of your space, the age group and a photo or two. We will suggest a theme that suits the ground and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

items.q: Can a small school in North Dum Dum fit a themed play station?
items.a: Many themed structures come in more than one size. Send us your measurements and we will suggest one that fits, with the safe play area marked on the layout.

items.q: Can the colours be matched to our school's branding?
items.a: Yes. We offer more than 15 roto-moulded colour shades and can customise designs on request. Tell us your school colours when you send the enquiry.

items.q: Do you install in Dum Dum, Baranagar and nearby areas?
items.a: Yes. Equipment is dispatched by road from Vasai and installed by our own team or a dealer who covers the Kolkata area.
